$comment: Security policy for muse-ready. Human-owned: the Ralph guard hook blocks agent edits to this file. Changing it is a reviewed decision.

requiredTests: refuses hosts that resolve to private or loopback addresses
re-checks the address on every redirect
never sends a method other than GET, HEAD or OPTIONS
aborts responses larger than the size limit
only sends credentials to the declared server host
never writes credentials into any report format
only POSTs JSON-RPC initialize and tools/list, and refuses every other MCP method
never follows a redirect on a POST
sends no POST at all without --probe-mcp
probeSecurityTests.$comment: POST exception approved by Oscar 2026-09-25: --probe-mcp may POST initialize, notifications/initialized and tools/list to the declared MCP endpoint only.
